title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(江村伯夫研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Emura Norio)
educationalGoal: In this final course, Each student will be expected to find a unique theme related to Media Informatics, thinkking about problems scientifically , and then proposing and implementing a solutions to those problems. Students will be expected to integrate their acquired knowledge on the technologies, sensibilities, and logical thinking skills related to media technology and media design in order to implement a project design method based on "CDIO" cycle.
advice: In Design Project III, each student will work on a unique theme based on the classes from the first to third years of study with the Department of Media Informatics. The primary theme of this laboratory aims at investigating the mechanisms of music perception, cognition and generation and constructing a support system for musical activities. Hence, students have to learn the interdisciplinary knowledge such as psychology and music theory besides media infomatics. Learning tips: In this cource, students will work on individually selected themes over the course of a year. Hence, each students will be required to execute their project systematically. These experiences will surely be useful when going out into society.
requiredKnowledge: All prerequisite courses of this department must already be completed. Especially, students must be able to summarize what they have learned in "Media informatics I ", "Media Informatics III" and "Acoustical and Musical Processing".

activityGoals.body: Be able to acquire basic skills as a creative engineer by experiencing problem discovery and solution techniques
Be able to explain about their fields of specialization.
Be able to deepen personal insights related to engineering ethics.
Be able to apply their specialized expertise to their project themes.
Be able to research their project themes based on CDIO.

lessons.content: Each week, students will report to each other on the progress of their individual research themes and the results of their study of given issues. Students are expected to help each other improve their respective research contents through discussions. Students will make presentations on and off campus, as appropriate, in terms of results. An intermediate presentation will be made during the summer vacation. (200 min * 15 weeks)
lessons.operation: Presentation Discussion Teacher advice and guidance Self-check
lessons.assignments: For each research theme, Students should proceed on specific work such as system R&D, demonstration experiments, document creations, etc. The first half will be focused on design and development.

lessons.content: Each week, students will report to each other on the progress of their individual research themes and the results of their study of given issues. Students are expected to help each other improve their respective research contents through discussions. Students will make presentations on campus and off campus, as appropriate, in terms of results. The research results will be summarized by December and all documents will be completed by January. They will then be presented at the public presentation review meeting. (200 min * 15 weeks)
lessons.operation: Presentation Discussion Teacher advice and guidance Self-check
lessons.assignments: For each research theme, Students should proceed on specific work such as system R&D, demonstration experiments, document creation, etc. The second half will focus on evaluation, improvement and documentation.
